Entity.comment: *1:1 relationship, one subtype defined. exclusive IsA subtypes (mono-hierarchical, optional from father to child) can be drawn as subtypes in the entity. An IsA relationship always starts with subtype (from child to father). This relationship (child to father) cannot be optional.
